scripts.ci:version: pnpm exec changeset version && pnpm run emit
scripts.validate: pnpm run emit:check && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm -C packages/kairos test && pnpm -C packages/cdd-engine test && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run version-sync && pnpm run check:no-bare-functions
scripts.precommit: pnpm run emit:check && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm -C packages/kairos test && pnpm -C packages/cdd-engine exec vitest run src-next/face/__tests__/channel-closure.guard.test.ts src-next/face/__tests__/words.guard.test.ts src-next/session/__tests__/handoff-plane.guard.test.ts && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run version-sync && pnpm run check:no-bare-functions
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/cdd-engine && tsc --noEmit -p scripts && tsc --noEmit -p packages/kairos/tests
